Visit note | 2026-02-07 09:00 AM | Dr. Tahmina Begum, Dermatology | Patient: Ziaur Karim, 61, male. Mr. Karim presents with itchy raised welts that come and go, noting that his symptoms started after a new food or medicine. He explains that the trouble started after eating prawns at a restaurant in Mohammadpur. He works as a construction worker and has no known chronic illnesses. On examination, he has about 35 welts on the trunk and arms. Vitals: BP 131/78 mmHg, pulse 88 bpm, weight 72 kg. Assessment: Acute urticaria. Plan: a prescription was issued. Advice given: avoid the suspected food, keep a symptom diary, and go to hospital at once if the tongue or throat swells. Follow-up in 2 weeks with the symptom diary.
